company.name: Orix AI
company.description:
Orix is an ultra-fast AI agent and intelligent blockchain execution engine. By combining advanced AI reasoning with smart contract capabilities, Orix automates complex technical tasks, allowing developers, founders, traders, and enterprises to build and scale decentralized applications in seconds.
The platform provides an all-in-one blockchain development suite, featuring automated smart contract generation (ranging from standard tokens to complex DeFi protocols), lightning-fast security auditing, vulnerability detection, and gas optimization tools. Orix accelerates product timelines by automating the engineering workflows behind backend architecture, frontend Web3 implementation, and tokenomics design.
